ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed distribution dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels across >95% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized point and linear features.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black contiguous regions across both lobes; localized high-contrast white pixel clusters at the distal tips; scattered white linear segments across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 45 degrees and a deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, small-amplitude serrations; distinct micro-indentations visible on the inner trailing edges of both lobes; overall edge remains relatively continuous with minor peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dense clusters of high-intensity white pixels (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter each) localized specifically at the extreme distal points of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (scratches) of varying lengths (10-50 pixels) and orientations scattered across the entire visible black surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive network of white linear rake marks across the ventral surface; small white clusters at fluke tips indicating past or current epibiont colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique combination of deep median notch and concentrated white tip clusters against a nearly uniform black background.
